create.name: Cynthia Abulafia
create.bio:
Cynthia Abulafia, a writer, educator and yoga therapist living in Santa Barbara, California, was initiated in a Shākta Tantra lineage of the Goddess. She studied in Naropa University's master's programme in yogic studies. For around twenty years she has explored different forms of non-duality alongside the scriptures of yoga and tantra, and for many years she designed and led yoga teacher trainings, among them as a lead trainer at Yoga Soup in Santa Barbara.

At the centre of her teaching are the divine feminine and what she calls the "transcendence bias": spiritual paths that show people how to rise above the body but not how to come back to it. Drawing on her own kundalini awakening, she supports people going through spiritual emergence with grounded practices of breath, the body, chanting and close reading of sacred texts. Monkfish published her first book, Embodying the Goddess, in 2026. She runs in-person workshops in California, a streamed course on the history and texts of yoga and Goddess tantra, a free book-club course and short talks on YouTube, and she writes on Substack.

books.title: Embodying the Goddess: How to Awaken Curiosity and Reverence on the Spiritual Path
books.author: Cynthia Abulafia
books.description: A guide to goddess spirituality from within the Shākta Tantra tradition, published by Monkfish in 2026. Abulafia examines the 'transcendence bias' of many spiritual paths and offers curiosity and reverence as ways back into the body and everyday life, drawing on history, sacred texts and personal story.

courses.title: Embodying the Goddess: The Sacred Texts, Histories, and Practices of Yogic and Tantric Traditions with a Focus on Goddess Tantra
courses.description: An eight-week course streamed online on Tuesday mornings (Pacific time), tracing the history of yoga and sacred sound through the Vedas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita and Yoga Sutra, then early tantra and the Goddess traditions. Each class includes breathwork, chanting and meditation alongside the study of texts.

free_resources.title: Book Club: Embodying the Goddess
free_resources.description: A free self-paced companion course to her book, designed for women's circles and book clubs. Short video lessons and reflection questions move through three parts: Mother is Calling, The Heart and Becoming.
